assertion_results.text: Bug parsing correctly extracts all four required sections (Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Result, Actual Result) using the heading formats from bug-template-mock.md (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lines 34-39 list the template heading formats (`### **Issue Description**`, `### **Steps to Reproduce**`, `### **Expected Result**`, `### **Actual Result**`) and mark all four as 'Present in Issue: Yes'. Lines 45-70 then show the parsed content of each section.

assertion_results.text: Bug validation confirms the issue type ID (10020) matches the Bug issue type ID from Bug Configuration (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lines 26-28: 'Bug issue type ID from issue: **10020**', 'Bug issue type ID from Bug Configuration: **10020**', 'Match: **YES** -- validated'.

assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause -- line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md lines 20-21: 'The heading extraction at `line[3:]` slices from character index 3 onward but does **not** strip trailing whitespace. When a heading line contains trailing spaces (e.g., `## Migration Patterns  \n`), the extracted section name becomes `"Migration Patterns  "` (with trailing spaces).'

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md line 5: what is broken -- 'extracts CONVENTIONS.md section headings using `line[3:]`, which captures all characters after the `## ` prefix without stripping trailing whitespace'. Lines 9-10: where -- 'plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md -- convention conformance analysis section'. Lines 21-24: how to verify -- 'Add a reproducer test that uses a CONVENTIONS.md fixture with trailing whitespace on a heading line, confirming the convention is correctly matched'.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST acceptance criterion -- before any fix criteria (Step 5 Acceptance Criteria ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md line 34 (first acceptance criterion): '- [ ] Reproducer test: a test with trailing whitespace on a `CONVENTIONS.md` heading confirms the convention is matched and included in the generated task description'. The fix criterion ('line[3:] is replaced with line[3:].strip()') comes second on line 35.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST test requirement -- with explicit assertion guidance derived from the Steps to Reproduce (Step 5 Test Requirements ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md line 40 (first test requirement): '- [ ] Reproducer test: create a `CONVENTIONS.md` fixture with trailing whitespace on at least one heading (e.g., `## Migration Patterns  `) and assert the convention is discovered and matched correctly'. This is first, and includes explicit assertion guidance ('assert the convention is discovered and matched correctly') with the Migration Patterns example from Steps to Reproduce.

assertion_results.text: Task description includes a Bug Context section with Bug key (ACME-500), Steps to Reproduce, Expected/Actual Result, and Root Cause summary (Step 5 Bug Context extension)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md lines 17-25: '## Bug Context' section contains: Bug key 'ACME-500', Steps to Reproduce (3 steps), Expected Result ('The generated task's Implementation Notes should include...'), Actual Result ('do NOT reference the Migration Patterns convention'), and Root Cause ('Heading extraction uses line[3:] without stripping trailing whitespace').

assertion_results.text: Task description sets Target Branch to main (Step 5 Target Branch)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md lines 9-10: '## Target Branch' followed by 'main'.

assertion_results.text: Task description output includes ai-generated-jira in the Jira API metadata block showing it would be passed as a label to jira.create_issue (Step 5 Task creation)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md lines 1-5: '<!-- Jira API metadata -->' / '<!-- jira.create_issue parameters: -->' / '<!-- project: ACME -->' / '<!-- issueType: Task -->' / '<!-- labels: ["ai-generated-jira"] -->'.
